executive_summary.issue: Emotion model producing 'sad' for nearly all production inputs

step_1_raw_model_output.conclusion: Model raw predictions are diverse and reasonable. Base model is NOT broken.

step_2_label_mapping.conclusion: Label mapping is correct. No configuration errors.

step_3_normalization.conclusion: Very quiet audio (<-40dB) triggers 'sad', and post-processing AMPLIFIES it

step_4_feature_variance.conclusion: Feature embeddings are well-separated. Model has learned discriminative features.

step_5_model_mode.conclusion: Model configuration is correct. Proper eval mode.

step_6_class_imbalance.conclusion: Slight weight bias toward 'sad' but not severe. Not primary issue.

step_7_fusion_layer.conclusion: No fusion layer in production code path

issues_found: Boosts sad confidence by 1.10x for low energy audio
Additional boost of 1.03x for matching acoustic profile
No similar scaling for other emotions
findings.code_pattern: if top_label == 'sad' and energy_band in {'very_low', 'low'}: scaled['sad'] *= 1.10
findings.impact: Transforms borderline sad predictions (50-60%) into high confidence (65-70%)

step_8_postprocessing.conclusion: THIS IS THE PRIMARY ROOT CAUSE - Post-processing incorrectly amplifies sad predictions

results.description: High pitch + high energy (should be happy)
High energy + harsh tone (should be angry)
Low energy + low pitch (should be sad)

step_9_controlled_tests.conclusion: Model shows discrimination ability. Not perfect but functional.

primary_issue.name: Post-processing confidence scaling error
primary_issue.mechanism: Method boosts 'sad' confidence by 10-13% for low energy audio, creating feedback loop that amplifies model bias
primary_issue.production_impact: Borderline sad predictions become dominant, causing 90%+ sad rate in production

secondary_issue.name: Model slight energy bias
secondary_issue.description: wav2vec2-base-superb-er has learned correlation between low energy and sadness from training data
secondary_issue.production_impact: Contributes to issue but is acceptable if post-processing is fixed

issues_ruled_out: Raw logits issue - Model outputs are diverse
Label mapping issue - Mapping is correct
Model mode issue - Correctly in eval mode
Major class imbalance - Biases are minor

compound_failure_chain: 1. Production audio has variable recording levels (TTS, quiet speakers, distant mics)
2. AudioPreprocessor normalizes but preserves relative energy characteristics
3. Model sees low-energy features → weakly predicts 'sad' (e.g., 52% confidence)
6. If acoustic profile matches sad (low pitch, low spectral centroid): scaled['sad'] *= 1.03
7. Renormalization distributes remaining probability, further strengthening sad
9. Over many predictions: slight model tendency + aggressive post-processing = 90%+ sad
why_this_is_wrong: Post-processing assumes model is under-confident about sad → wrong assumption
Low energy does not always mean sadness in production contexts
Creates feedback loop instead of correcting model errors
Asymmetric treatment - only modifies sad, not other emotions
No calibration data to justify the 1.10x multiplier

option_a_safest.name: Disable confidence scaling entirely
option_a_safest.action: Comment out call to _apply_confidence_scaling() in predict() method
option_a_safest.implementation: Replace scaling call with direct use of canonical_scores
pros: Lets model predictions pass through unchanged
cons: Loses any potential calibration benefits (if they exist)
option_a_safest.expected_impact: Reduce sad predictions from 90%+ to model baseline (estimated 10-20%)

option_b_targeted.name: Fix confidence scaling logic
option_b_targeted.action: Reverse energy-based scaling to be skeptical of quiet→sad
option_b_targeted.implementation: Change multiplier from 1.10 to 0.85 for low energy
option_b_targeted.expected_impact: Reduce sad predictions significantly, but behavior less predictable

option_c_longterm.name: Replace or retrain model
option_c_longterm.action: Use different emotion model or fine-tune current one
alternatives: emotion2vec - More robust to volume variation
Fine-tune wav2vec2 on normalized, balanced emotion data
pros: Addresses root cause at model level

monitoring.success_criteria: No new issues, emotion distribution normalized

evaluation.action: Analyze emotion distribution and user feedback

verification_test.test_case: Quiet neutral audio (200 Hz sine, 0.05 amplitude)
verification_test.expected_after_fix: neutral, happy, or angry (NOT high-confidence sad)
